description: This file contains unit tests for the Session class within the 'openbb_cli' module. It uses pytest framework and mocks to verify the behavior of session initialization and input prompt methods.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: A class representing a user session in the CLI application, including settings, styles, and input handling.

methods.name: mock_isatty(return_value)
methods.description: Mocks the sys.stdin.isatty method to simulate interactive or non-interactive terminal environments.

methods.name: session()
methods.description: Pytest fixture that creates and provides a Session object for tests.

methods.name: test_session_initialization(session)
methods.description: Verifies that a Session object initializes its properties correctly.

methods.name: test_get_prompt_session_true(mock_isatty, session)
methods.description: Tests that _get_prompt_session returns a session object when isatty is True.

methods.name: test_get_prompt_session_false(mock_isatty, session)
methods.description: Tests that _get_prompt_session returns None when isatty is False.
